name: South Dakota
agency: South Dakota Department of Public Safety (DPS), Driver Licensing Program
permitAge: 14 (instruction permit, valid 5 years; driving 6 a.m.-10 p.m. with qualified adult beside)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours (at least 10 in inclement weather and 10 at night), parent attests in writing - permits issued after July 1, 2020
teen.holdPermit: 275 days, or 180 days with approved driver education (permits issued after July 1, 2020)
teen.nightLimit: Restricted minor's permit: alone 6 a.m.-10 p.m. with parent permission; 10 p.m.-6 a.m. only with parent/guardian, except direct trips to/from school, church, work or farm work
teen.passengerLimit: Restricted minor's permit: first 6 months only immediate family/household; after that max one non-family passenger under 18
teen.phone: Instruction and restricted minor's permit holders: no wireless communication device while driving (2013 law). Adult rule unresolved (texting ban; 2025 HB 1117 hands-free status not confirmed)

notes: Full operator's license at 16 after 6 months on restricted minor's permit with no traffic convictions in prior 6 months
Under-18 traffic conviction or permit violation: 30-day suspension (DPS handout)
Knowledge test: 80% to pass (sd.gov); question count only from third-party sites (25) - not confirmed officially; driver ed can waive the permit knowledge test (third-party)
2025 SB 193: written knowledge test must be offered in English or Spanish
Official manuals page lists English and Spanish driver license manuals (Driver_License_Manual_Spanish.pdf); direct PDF URL not captured
Interstate rural limit 80 mph since 2015 (lower near towns)

Move Over (expanded July 1, 2025): covers any vehicle on shoulder with amber/yellow/blue lights, moving slowly or stopped; multi-lane: move to farthest lane at least 300 ft before; two-lane: slow 20 mph below limit (5 mph if limit 20 or less); min fine $270
School bus: on highway with 2+ lanes each direction, opposite-direction traffic need not stop; stopping distance unclear (15 or 20 ft) - check SDCL 32-32-6
